# Feature request

## Problem and audience

Who needs this and what problem does it solve?

## Proposed change

Describe scope, affected documents and alternatives considered.

## Acceptance criteria

List verifiable outcomes and evidence required. Application implementation belongs in its independent repository.

## Checks

- [ ] I searched existing issues.
- [ ] I described security and documentation implications.
- [ ] I did not present planned outcomes as delivered results.
